scope: Screen the newly surfaced go-cad DWG/DXF implementation, assess evidence independence and ACIS scope, and reconcile current ACIS writer/loss issue status before updating the existing optional comparator matrix.

method.kind: Primary-source repository, versioned Go module documentation, release page, and current issue/PR status review
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: latest downstream-consumer and new-peer capability review matrix and comparator admission rules
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: implementation order, fast-test cadence, and deferred external J ledger
method.limitations: Project feature, corpus, differential, fuzz, and reliability numbers are README claims and were not independently reproduced. The examined Go module is an untagged pseudo-version; GitHub lists no formal releases. No run was performed and no file was downloaded.

evidence.observed: The project describes a pure-Go/no-cgo DWG R9-R2018 and ASCII/binary DXF reader/writer, with separate container, object-record, entity, object, model, renderer, and writer packages. The inspected pkg.go.dev module snapshot is v0.0.0-20261001090957-ddd91eea9618, published 2026-10-01, and is not tagged or stable; its GitHub release page lists no releases. The README says its decoded values are checked against LibreDWG dwgread -O JSON and its DXF writing against LibreDWG dxf2dwg.

A distinct Go implementation can be a useful implementation-diverse structural/explicit-entity differential, but the project's own advertised expected-value baseline is LibreDWG-derived, so agreement is reference-correlated rather than a fully independent semantic oracle. Its documented ACIS entity path extracts/stores SAT/SAB bytes as a blob and explicitly has no ACIS geometry kernel; this cannot establish B-rep topology, solid validity, AcDs ownership/index association, or native 3D acceptance.

ACadSharp PR #1240 remains open and undeployed and is described as depending on #1174; LibreDWG issue #1411 remains open with the reported modern AcDs/SAB loss. These statuses do not constitute current released writer behavior or an independent local defect reproduction.

readinessRefinement: classify go-cad as an optional structural and explicit-entity differential, not a mandatory peer, dependency, or CI gate
bind any optional future run to an immutable commit, Go toolchain, exact input bytes, and per-handle/type/owner/loss report
do not count agreement with LibreDWG-derived expectations as an independent oracle result
do not use go-cad's ACIS blob retention for B-rep, AcDs join, or 3D consumer claims
keep local generated fast tests as the implementation loop; use a peer only at the existing composed checkpoint when a concrete unresolved family warrants it
